title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E16 — A Dawn to Remember
When model Dawn Koons, 18, heads to California with dreams of stardom, her family back in Yonkers worry she's made a mistake; within months, her body is found in her bathtub; police have a suspect but unmasking her killer takes nearly 40 years.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E06 — The Devil in Disguise
Twenty-three-year-old teacher Irene Garza is a former beauty queen and devout Catholic who vanishes the evening before Easter; residents of her close-knit border town do their best to locate her, but her body is found floating in a drainage canal.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E01 — The Voice in the Lake
When 31-year-old real estate appraiser Mike Williams mysteriously vanishes while duck hunting in the Florida swamps in December 2000, authorities suspect he accidentally drowned.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E02 — Devil at the Door
When 36-year-old computer programmer Lisa Valdez fails to show up for work, her apartment manager finds her brutally murdered in her tiny studio; her body is riddled with stab wounds, and the walls are covered in blood.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E03 — Murder in the Midwest
The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, but the search for her killer finally begins when the cause of death is changed to homicide 40 years later.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E12 — Damn His Soul to Hell
The 1964 murder of 9-year-old Marise Chiverella leaves the town of Hazleton, Pa., in fear; an intense manhunt yields numerous suspects but no killer; five decades pass before a student moonlighting as a genetic genealogist reignites the case.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S01 E10 — A Killer Slips Away
Police learn the key witness in the stabbing death of a beloved aunt was an imposter; a return to the crime scene reveals a clue hidden in plain sight.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E07 — Steven Jones
After being sucker punched during a campus gathering, Northern Arizona University freshman Steven Jones shoots four fellow students, injuring three and killing one; facing life in prison, Jones tries to convince the jury that it was self-defense.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E04 — Lori Phillips
A year after discovering her husband's frozen body in the driveway, Lori Phillips faces charges for his death; facing up to 25 years in prison, Lori has decided to testify, hoping to persuade the jury that she was fleeing from an abusive man.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E05 — Katie Magbanua
A beloved college professor is executed in Tallahassee, Fla.; the investigation leads to murder charges against a trio from Miami; in a risky move, the woman who connected the killers to the people who hired them decides to take the stand.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E08 — Henry Segura
A young mother and her three children are brutally murdered in their suburban Florida home; Henry Segura is taking the stand in his own defense in an attempt to convince the jury not to sentence him to death.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E09 — Jessica Groves
A couple from Ohio are charged with 11 felonies, including the death of their infant son, whose injury-riddled body was found in a well.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E01 — George Burch
George Burch stands accused of the brutal murder of Nicole VanderHeyden, a 31-year-old mother of three; George willingly takes the stand to prove he is not guilty and to provide the jury with an alternative suspect.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E06 — Lindsay Partin
Hannah Wesche dies of head trauma and the babysitter who cared for her is indicted for her murder; Lindsay Partin takes the stand to defend her innocence and to try to explain several suspicious statements she gave to police detectives.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E02 — James Scandirito
A son finds his father slumped over dead near a pile of cocaine; he dismembers the body to conceal the crime; James Scandirito, Jr. takes the stand to explain why he thought he had to dismember and bury what he claims was his already deceased father.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E07 — Roy Oliver
A routine response to a noise complaint takes a devastating turn when Roy Oliver, a Dallas police officer, shoots and kills unarmed 15-year-old Jordan Edwards; Roy Oliver takes the stand in an attempt to explain his state of mind.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E03 — Claudia Hoerig
When a woman shoots her pilot husband and flees to Brazil, she sets off a long battle for her extradition and trial in the States; Claudia Hoerig takes the stand to tell a harrowing story about the end of her troubled marriage.

When a woman shoots her pilot husband and flees to Brazil, she sets off a long battle for her extradition and trial in the States; Claudia Hoerig takes the stand to tell a harrowing story about the end of her troubled marriage.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E07 — Steven Jones
After being sucker punched during a campus gathering, Northern Arizona University freshman Steven Jones shoots four fellow students, injuring three and killing one; facing life in prison, Jones tries to convince the jury that it was self-defense.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E04 — Lori Phillips
A year after discovering her husband's frozen body in the driveway, Lori Phillips faces charges for his death; facing up to 25 years in prison, Lori has decided to testify, hoping to persuade the jury that she was fleeing from an abusive man.

title: Court Cam Presents Under Oath
description:
S01 E05 — Katie Magbanua
A beloved college professor is executed in Tallahassee, Fla.; the investigation leads to murder charges against a trio from Miami; in a risky move, the woman who connected the killers to the people who hired them decides to take the stand.
